text:
maria: Heads up — ACME customer hit sustained 502s on hosted inference last hour, but it’s not a full outage. They see long-tail failures and client retries amplifying load. trace_id=18f3b7a2

maria: Customer timeline: normal traffic then a ~10–15% 502 rate for ~12m, long latencies before 502, clients retry aggressively and we see amplification. They pasted curl sample and says it "keeps failing after ~4 tries".

danielle: Can you paste the curl + headers they used? suspecting a retry header or client-side aggressive backoff.

maria: curl they used: 
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"hi","stream":false}'
```
They also have a custom retry wrapper in front of the SDK.

alex: Pushed a quick log extract — edge logs show a pattern: upstream returned 502 after ~6s of backend stall, then client replays within 1s causing queueing. snippet: 
```
[2026-03-20T18:01:14Z] ingress edge req_id=18f3b7a2 route=/v1/generate upstream_status=502 upstream_time=6.3s queue_wait=0.2s
[2026-03-20T18:01:15Z] ingress edge req_id=18f3b7a3 route=/v1/generate upstream_status=502 upstream_time=6.1s queue_wait=0.3s
[2026-03-20T18:01:16Z] ingress edge req_id=18f3b7a4 route=/v1/generate upstream_status=200 upstream_time=0.45s queue_wait=0.1s
```
Not all requests fail, but retries cluster and we see short bursts.

sre-jen: Looks like long-tail backend stalls (~6s) produce a 502 path in Envoy; combined with client retries you get fanout. Two-pronged approach: immediate mitigation + postmortem.

sre-jen: Immediate mitigations to try now:
- disable automatic client retries for that tenant (ask customer to toggle), or set header `X-Client-Retry: 0` if they can.
- server-side: apply route-level retry budget in Envoy to limit retry amplification (example patch below).
- temporary uplift upstream pool for hostedapi (increase conn pool or burst capacity for Dedicated pool).

danielle: Can you paste the envoy retry snippet? want a config we can test in staging.

sre-jen: Example (staging) config: 
```yaml
retry_policy:
  retry_on: 5xx,connect,retriable-status
  num_retries: 1   # limit retries to 1 for now
  per_try_timeout: 3s
  retry_back_off:
    base_interval: 200ms
    max_interval: 1s
```
This reduces amplification and forces faster failover.

alex: Also saw increased `client-replay` header in many failures — customer SDK was replaying with no jitter. Asked them to add randomized exponential backoff and not to retry on 5xx unless idempotent.

maria: Customer replied — they can toggle retries but it will take ~20 mins to deploy. Meanwhile they asked if Redwood can do a temporary route-level change.

sre-jen: I can roll a targeted route change for that tenant in edge config (canary to 10% then 100% if metrics look good). Will annotate as a hotfix. Tagging ops-bot to record the change.

ops-bot: Change queued: edge-route-update tenant=acme route=/v1/generate retry_policy=num_retries:1 targeted_canary=10% initiated_by=sre-jen ticket=INC-5632

danielle: For repro — we can simulate the amplification with this script: 
```bash
for i in {1..50}; do
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-test" \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"spam","stream":false}' \
    https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
done
wait
```
Run with a modified SDK that retries immediately (no jitter) to reproduce the fanout.

maria: After we applied route change (canary 10% -> 100%) the 502 rate dropped from 12% -> 1.5% within ~4m. customer rolled out their client change and saw improved stability.

alex: Postmortem notes to add:
- root cause: transient backend stall (~6s) that triggers Envoy 502 path when per-try timeout exceeded.
- contributing: aggressive client-side retry with near-zero backoff causing request amplification.
- detection: edge metrics spike in 502s + short inter-arrival times between same tenant requests.
- mitigations: route-level retry caps, per-tenant burst capacity, docs for SDK retry guidance, and add a dashboard alert for retry-amplified 5xx patterns.

maria: Filing follow-ups: create KB for customer-facing retry guidance, plan a config knob for `X-Disable-Retry`, and run a chaos test to exercise 6s backend stalls.

sre-jen: I'll open PR to our routing repo with the envoy retry_policy patch and link the canary run. assigning to danielle for verification.

danielle: Got it, will verify in staging and post graphs to the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
